verdict.rationale: The dot is a built-in always-on agent that users hand work to: it keeps working in the cloud on its own computer and browser, runs background agents in parallel, accepts scheduled recurring tasks, and can sub-delegate to ChatGPT Work or Codex. Users can inspect that delegated work under Activity, take over control, and set handling rules. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that delegated tasks complete reliably (all evidence is first-party docs; the probes only confirm the docs exist).
